about.introduction: Hello and welcome, I am Florence Lefevre, a Gameplay Programmer. Throughout my studies and professional experiences, I have worked on various aspects of game development, including asset integration, code optimization, gameplay programming, and game feel. I have a particular interest in 3C and network programming, as well as tools programming.
about.dev-skills: I am trained in C++,Blueprint,C# and have experience working with the following game engines: Godot,Unity,Unreal.
about.design-skills: I also had the opportunity to learn about game design. Through various projects, I was able to develop my skills in Level design, and UX design.
